 1  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 039-2024, declaring the results of the General

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, provided a staff report.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio to
  approve recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 039-2024.

 B. PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

 1.  Recommend to (1) adopt Resolution No. 035-2024, adopting the City’s 6th Cycle Housing
  Element; (2) adopt Resolution No. 037-2024, adopting the Initial Study for the 6th Cycle
  Housing Element Update; (3) Conduct first reading of Ordinance No. 2024-620, amending
  Sections 18.30, 18.40, 18.50, 18.55, 18.60, 18.70, 18.90, 18.100 and 18.110 of the City of
  Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code, and amending the Zoning Code Map; and (4) adopt
  Resolution No. 036-2024, adopting the amended General Plan Land Use Element and Map.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Tonya Pace, Senior Planner, introduced the item.

  Grant Henninger, Mobius Planning, provided a presentation.

  Patrick Donegan, City Attorney, spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan recused himself for site #5, the Auto Zone site.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio, to
  approve inclusion of Site 5, the Auto Zone site, as a Housing Element housing site and
  reflect that inclusion in the General Plan Land Use Element Map and Zoning Code Map.

  The motion Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Del Rio, Roa, Vargas, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 1; Farfan

  Motion Carried: 4–0–0–1

  A motion was made by Mayor Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Resolutions Nos. 035-2024, 036-2024, 037-2024; and declare
  Ordinance No. 2024-620, read the first time and laid over to the next regular meeting for final
  reading, as amended, for the referenced ADU Code Section 18.90.080 to be identical to
  Ordinance No. 2024-618.

  The motion Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Del Rio, Roa, Vargas, De Paula, Farfan
  NOES: 0;

 D. DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

 1.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 040-2024, approving the Memorandum of
  Understanding between the City of Hawaiian Gardens and the American Federation of
  State, County, and Municipal Employees AFL-CIO, Local 3624, Council 36, Rank and File
  Unit.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Patrick Donegan, City Attorney, presented the staff report.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  Councilmember Farfan spoke.

  Mayor De Paula spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio, to
  approve recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 040-2024, as amended, for Section 2 to
  read as follows: The Mayor and the City Manager are authorized to execute the attached
  MOU, and the form attached hereto as Exhibit 1, which will have effect according to the
  terms when signed by the authorized representatives of all parties, at that time the expired
  MOU and all other side letter agreements between the parties shall be deemed superseded
  and rescinded; and for Section 3 to read as follows: The City Manager is directed to continue
  to work with AFSCME on any required side letter to clarify or explain any unforeseen or
  unresolved issues as deemed necessary.

  The motion Carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Del Rio, Roa, Vargas, De Paula, Farfan
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion Carried: 5–0–0–0

 E. NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

 F. ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director reported that they held a successful
tree lighting event; that registration is open for youth winter camp and youth basketball league; and
announced that the deadline for the youth scholarship program is December 19, 2024.

 G. CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

 H. ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio thanked staff who participated in tree lighting event; and thanked
Supervisor Janice Hahn for donating a float.

Councilmember Farfan thanked staff for their work for the holiday events.

Mayor De Paula thanked the community and the City of Hawaiian Gardens for the opportunity to
serve.

 I.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

 J. ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:34 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be
held on Wednesday, January 8, 2024 at 6:00 PM.
